Currently, Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) lead the IPL 2026 points table with 8 points and a net run rate of +1.503. Rajasthan Royals (RR) are placed at second with 8 points, followed by Punjab Kings (PBKS) in third position with 7 points. Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH) occupy the fourth spot in the IPL 2026 standings with 4 points, while Delhi Capitals (DC) are placed fifth and Gujarat Titans (GT) hold the sixth position in the table. Further down the standings, Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) are ranked seventh, followed by Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in eighth place. Mumbai Indians (MI) and Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) currently sit in the ninth and tenth positions respectively in the IPL points table. The standings not only reflect total points but also Net Run Rate (NRR), wins, and overall team consistency, which play a crucial role in defining the IPL 2026 points table rankings. With several matches still to be played, the IPL 2026 points table is expected to see frequent changes as teams battle for playoff qualification. Stay tuned for regular updates on team standings, rankings, and the race to the top four.
